name: NGC 4457, SN 2020nvb field (Hubble)
blurb: NGC 4457, a lenticular galaxy in the Virgo Cluster, seen by Hubble.
label: ngc4457-hubble
story: NGC 4457 hosted SN 2020nvb, a Type Ia supernova, one of the exploding stars astronomers use as standard candles. Hubble looked at the galaxy's outer stars, whose old red giants act as a cosmic yardstick for measuring its distance and calibrating the supernova scale.
